content:
priya_cs: Heads-up — prepping an exec-facing QBR for Hyperion (renewal window next month). Meeting set Tue 10am PT. Need final deck: health snapshot, onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement asks. Who can scrub slides today? @liam_success @sofia_csm
liam_success: I can take health + onboarding slides. Will pull latest usage metrics and onboarding timeline. ETA EOD today.
sofia_csm: I'll own renewal risks + enablement asks. Can we consolidate product feedback into one slide? @amanda_pm
amanda_pm: Link to feedback doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/folders/hyperion-feedback — I’ll add notes by 3pm. Request access if you can't see it.
noah_sales: FYI exec wants a single 'ask' slide: renewal ask + top risks. Keep it concise. I'll draft the ask.
qbr-bot: Reminder: use QBR template v2 in /templates/qbr_2026_v2.pptx
priya_cs: Ok, assigning owners in-code for clarity:
```
- Health slide: liam_success (EOD)
- Onboarding timeline: liam_success (EOD)
- Renewal risks: sofia_csm (EOD)
- Enablement asks: sofia_csm + amanda_pm (tomorrow 11am)
- Exec ask slide: noah_sales (tomorrow noon)
- Deck polish + speaker notes: priya_cs (Mon 9am)
```
sofia_csm: Quick question — any new compliance flags from the Private trials? I recall a brief incident last month.
liam_success: There's a short incident note in #incidents but nothing blocking renewal. I'll add a footnote and mitigation plan to the risks slide.
amanda_pm: Added customer quotes and the latest retention/usage numbers to the feedback doc. Excerpts: "needs better deploy observability", "request for longer retention".
noah_sales: For the exec ask: propose we ask for a 6‑month committed Dedicated block to stabilize pricing. Draft: "Commit to 6-month Dedicated capacity at preferential terms to secure performance and cost predictability." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sofia_csm: Agree in principle — we should show unit economics improvement if they commit. Can you include a simple before/after cost delta? @liam_success
liam_success: I can add a tiny chart (cost per token vs committed capacity). Need final usage numbers — Amanda, can you confirm the final month numbers?
amanda_pm: Confirmed — numbers are in the feedback doc (tab: metrics). Also added a short customer quote for narrative.
priya_cs: Can we do a 30-min dry run Mon 4pm PT? I'll send an invite and attach speaker notes.
sofia_csm: I can make the dry run.
noah_sales: Will join.
liam_success: I have a conflict until 4:30 — I'll watch the recording and add notes.
qbr-bot: Deploy bot: latest deck uploaded to /releases/qbr/hyperion_v3.pptx
priya_cs: Action items recap (quick):
- liam_success: health + onboarding slides + chart (EOD)
- sofia_csm: renewal risks + enablement asks (EOD)
- amanda_pm: feedback excerpts & numbers (3pm)
- noah_sales: exec ask draft (tomorrow noon)
- priya_cs: schedule dry run + finalize speaker notes (Mon 9am)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
sofia_csm: Added my slides and notes. :white_check_mark:
liam_success: Uploaded charts to the deck. :white_check_mark:
amanda_pm: Done with numbers and quotes. :white_check_mark:
noah_sales: Drafted the ask — putting it in the doc, want feedback on tone/amount. :speech_balloon:
priya_cs: Also logging a risk: potential ~10% renewal volatility if latency spikes persist. I'll add fallback (alternate routing & cache policies) under mitigations.
sofia_csm: Good call — I'll include mitigation text and owner (eng-runbook).
noah_sales: If we can show cost delta + mitigation, I'll lock the ask slide by EOD tomorrow.
priya_cs: Thanks team — I’ll post the final link after polish and send the dry-run invite. /cc @executive_team
